title: Unholy DK — how a Gladiator bursts
summary: A 4x Gladiator Unholy DK in 7 Gladiator-level games: Blinding Sleet, then Army and Dark Transformation within a second. Vampiric Strike does the damage.

evidence.note: 26 Sep 2026 · one player (4x Gladiator) in Walking Dead · every player a Gladiator

sections.title: Vampiric Strike is the damage; Army is the timing
sections.body: Vampiric Strike did 14% of his damage at 8.9 casts a minute, Putrefy 10%, Necrotic Coil 7%. His pets did over a quarter between them. Dread Plague's burst when dispelled, from the Life and Death PvP talent, added 6%. PvP talents in all 7 games: Spellwarden, Life and Death, Necrotic Wounds. One player's play across 10.5 minutes of arena: a proposal to correct.

steps.note: 1.3s before Army, 5 of 9 times: their team disoriented as the pets land.

sections.title: Burst: offensive cooldowns, all within three seconds

steps.note: The go starts here. 9 in 7 games.
Within a second of Army, 7 of 9 times.
About 2.4s after Army. 10% of his damage.
His biggest hitter: 14% of damage, 8.9 casts a minute.

sections.title: Burst: crowd control and the kick on their healer

steps.note: 4 to 10s after Army, in 4 of 9 bursts: as the damage peaks.
On their healer inside the burst: both kicks in a killing peak were his.

sections.title: Land the burst on their healer's CC
sections.body: The DK and Monk usually burst together. It killed when their healer was locked out or kicked during those 6 seconds (3 of 5 at this level) and rarely when their healer was free (1 of 7). The damage and the lockout were both there, and mostly not at the same time. The full comp read is in the Walking Dead guide.
